hooks.name: living_damage_pre
hooks.doc:
NeoForge's `LivingDamageEvent.Pre`: `LivingEntity.actuallyHurt` of entity `entity` of
type `kind` (`minecraft:player`, `minecraft:zombie`) by `source` (named as
`native_living_incoming_damage` names it) has taken armor and magic, and the absorption
hearts are next: `container` holds the damage it started with, what it is now
(`new_damage`, which may be 0) and each reduction so far (armor, enchantments, mob
effects). Change its
`new_damage` and the health takes that; set its post-attack invulnerability ticks and the
entity keeps them instead of vanilla's. A value that is not a number is put back as it
was. It fires for players, mobs and the ender dragon; a wolf whose armor takes the hit and
armor stands do not fire it. The level is the hit's: its blocks, random and own
attachments; the hurt entity is in the middle of its hit.

rust_summary: a hit's damage after armor and magic, before the absorption hearts and the health take it, that a mod can change (`native_living_damage_pre`).
doc_summary: the damage of a hit after armor and magic, as NeoForge's `LivingDamageEvent.Pre`: `native_living_damage_pre(level, entity, kind, source, container)` runs on the server in `LivingEntity.actuallyHurt` for a player, a mob or the ender dragon, after armor, enchantments and mob effects and before the absorption hearts take their share, even when nothing is left. `container` (`DamageContainer`) holds the original damage, the armor, enchantment and mob-effect reductions, the blocked and shield damage, and the new damage; change `new_damage` (0 takes no health) or the post-attack invulnerability ticks. `level` is the hit's level host: its blocks, random and own attachments. A wolf whose armor takes the hit and armor stands do not fire it.
